question: What Is Function Block Programming in DCS?
body_html:
DCS function block programming builds control strategies from small, standard blocks such as AI, AO and PID that are wired together graphically instead of written as lines of code. Function Block Diagram (FBD) is one of the five languages in IEC 61131-3.

BlockWhat it does
AIReads a 4 to 20 mA or HART value in engineering units
PIDCompares PV with setpoint every scan cycle
AOSends a 4 to 20 mA output to a valve or drive
DI and DORead and drive on/off devices
